subject: MSA redline + Ariba PO-ack exception request — MedSupply Co.
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@medsupplyco.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 May 2027 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: MSA + PO acknowledgement window for Ariba onboarding

Hi Mateo,

Thanks for the call earlier. MedSupply is ready to onboard into our Ariba instance but procurement has a strict PO acknowledgement SLA: their platform flags any vendor that does not ACK a PO within 48 hours. Our legal team has pushed for a 72-hour "ack by" clause in the MSA/Order Form due to internal processing.

Two asks:
- Can Redwood accept a 72-hour ack window in the Order Form, or will that block Ariba onboarding?
- If 72h is a hard no, what operational workaround exists on the portal side (gateway flags, manual ack override, SFTP acknowledgement mapping)?

Attaching their PO schema they supplied. Let me know who at Redwood we should loop for legal redlines and portal exceptions.

Thanks,
Liam O'Connor
Head of Procurement, MedSupply Co.
[Attachment: MedSupply_PO_Schema_v2.xlsx (XLSX)]

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 2 May 2027 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MSA + PO acknowledgement window for Ariba onboarding

Hi Liam — thanks for the detail and the schema. Looping in Kimberly (legal) and Marissa (onboarding/portal ops).

Quick notes:
- From an operational standpoint, Ariba tends to enforce a 48h ACK as a hard signal; we have implemented exceptions before but it requires a portal mapping change and a brief operational window.
- Kimberly — can legal confirm whether we can accept a 72-hour ack specifically for MedSupply via Order Form amendment (i.e., carve-out) or whether we should propose a different language?
- Marissa — can you flag whether the gateway or Ariba configuration would allow an "ackByOverride" for a single vendor and what steps/lead time that takes?

If legal is comfortable with a conditional Order Form clause, we can do DocuSign once redlines are approved and then schedule the portal change.

Thanks,
Mateo Alvarez
Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@medsupplyco.com>
Date: Tue, 3 May 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: RE: MSA + PO acknowledgement window for Ariba onboarding

Thanks for the ping. I reviewed the proposed MSA/Order Form language and spoke with Contracts. High level:

- We can accept a 72-hour PO acknowledgement window as a negotiated, customer-specific term, but we should not change the global MSA.
- Recommended approach: add a short Order Form addendum clause: "Notwithstanding Section X of the MSA, for the term of this Order Form the PO acknowledgement window for MedSupply Co. shall be 72 hours from issuance." This keeps the global MSA intact and scopes the deviation to the Order Form.
- Risk: Ariba's automated monitoring may still mark the vendor as non-compliant if the portal sends a default ACK flag. Marissa will need to confirm the portal behavior.

I've attached redlines: MSA_redline_MedSupply_20270503.pdf (highlights Order Form addendum) and OrderForm_Redline_20270503.docx (clean order form + tracked changes). Please review and confirm operational feasibility before we route to MedSupply for signature.

If operationally feasible, Legal can sign off and we'll produce a one-click DocuSign envelope for the Order Form addendum only.

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Contracts — Redwood Inference
[Attachment: MSA_redline_MedSupply_20270503.pdf (PDF)]
[Attachment: OrderForm_Redline_20270503.docx (DOCX)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@medsupplyco.com>
Date: Tue, 3 May 2027 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: RE: MSA + PO acknowledgement window for Ariba onboarding

Thanks — I checked the portal and ran the PO schema against our connector. Operational notes:

- Ariba default: the PO_ACK flag is treated as a binary acknowledgement and the portal flags vendors that have not acknowledged within 48h. There is no per-vendor adjustable SLA in the standard UI.
- Workaround (we've used this before): enable an "ackByOverride" at the gateway layer for the vendor's org ID which effectively suppresses the 48h enforcement for that vendor; this requires a configuration change and a short maintenance window (~2 business days).
- Alternative: configure an SFTP-based ACK feed (we can accept batched ACKs) — this is lower risk but requires MedSupply to support file-based ACKs and may add 3–5 business days.

I'll attach the proposed portal field mapping we would deploy to implement the ACK override. If Palo Alto/Gateway team approves the change, I can schedule the config work and smoke test in the staging Ariba instance.

Next steps I propose:
1) Legal to confirm the Order Form addendum language (Kim).
2) MedSupply to sign the addendum via DocuSign.
3) We schedule gateway config (2 business days) and validate in staging.

Attachments: portal_field_map.csv (field -> mapping note).

Marissa Cole
Onboarding Lead — Redwood Inference
[Attachment: portal_field_map.csv (CSV)]

Subject: Re: MSA + PO acknowledgement window for Ariba onboarding

Hi team — thanks for the quick turnaround. MedSupply is happy to accept an Order Form addendum (72-hour ack) scoped to this deployment. We prefer the gateway "ackByOverride" approach rather than SFTP if it reduces timeline.

Please proceed with:
- Kimberly: final sign-off on the addendum and DocuSign envelope.
- Marissa: schedule the gateway config as soon as legal confirms — MedSupply can do final smoke test on Friday after your staging validation.

Expecting DocuSign link and an estimated go-live date once the gateway window is booked.

Best,
Liam O'Connor
Head of Procurement, MedSupply Co.
